headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato. Sizes should scale fluidly up to text-5xl or text-6xl for the hero banner.

body.usage: Clean, readable, geometric. Use leading-relaxed for long descriptions. High legibility.

labels.usage: Uppercase, wide letter spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), text-xs or text-sm for overlines and category badges.

background.description: Soft white background providing a clean and premium canvas.

surface.description: Crisp white for product cards, floating headers, and modals.

accent_primary.description: Premium beige for soft emphasis and background layers.

accent_secondary.description: Light blue for badges, subtle highlights, and active states.

text.description: High contrast deep slate for readability. Never use pure #000000 without a slight tint.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Use large, friendly, but premium radii: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for main sections, rounded-xl for product cards, rounded-full for pills/badges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Apple-style soft, diffused ambient shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a subtle border-b). Solid backgrounds for product cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal. Keep it clean and architectural, letting the high-quality product images speak.

component_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), sharp interaction animations. Primary buttons use dark slate (bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800). Secondary use soft beige or light blue.
component_strategies.product_cards: Flat, minimalistic. Image is the hero. Remove heavy borders, use very subtle shadow on hover, translate-y by -2px on hover. Show add-to-cart/wishlist strictly on hover or as elegant circular floating buttons.
component_strategies.header: Sticky glassmorphic header, transparent over hero ONLY IF using gradient scrim/overlay so text is readable, else backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80. Must have logo, search, language switcher (EN/AR), cart.
component_strategies.cart_drawer: Shadcn Sheet component. Clean typography, clear product breakdown, sticky total and checkout button at the bottom.
component_strategies.filters: Sidebar or top horizontal bar. Use Shadcn Accordions and Checkboxes. Soft gray for unselected, dark slate for selected.

grids.hero: Asymmetric bento grid or large immersive hero. Mobile-first grid-cols-1.
grids.featured_categories: Bento Grid Protocol: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Mix of square (col-span-1) and wide (col-span-2) blocks.
grids.product_grid: High Density Protocol: grid-cols-2 (mobile) md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6 or gap-8.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Sections should have py-20 or py-32. Containers must use max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
layouts.alignment: Left-align product details and forms for readability. Center-align hero headlines if it improves balance.
layouts.rtl_support: CRITICAL: The site supports Arabic. Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., ms-4, pe-6, text-start, border-s) instead of physical properties (ml-4, pr-6, text-left, border-l) wherever applicable.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states (opacity change, subtle transform).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for product grids using framer-motion.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Text over images MUST have text-shadow or a gradient overlay underneath it. Normal text minimum 4.5:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.images: Images must be high quality. For mobile, hero images must not exceed 80vh. Use aspect-ratio utilities for product cards (aspect-[4/5] or aspect-square) to ensure uniform grids.
media.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (1.5 or 1.25) for a premium, delicate look.

3d_libraries_and_steps.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI transitions and react-fast-marquee for a 'Why Choose AllNeeds' or trust badge strip. No heavy 3D required, keep focus on real product photography.

hero_family.description: Happy family on green grass, representing trust, joy, and the premium lifestyle target of AllNeeds.

category_stroller.description: Mother bending over a premium stroller outdoors.

category_playtime.description: Man carrying a baby girl, representing playtime and daily care.

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Tailwind CSS with logical properties (start/end instead of left/right) for RTL (Arabic) support. Do not center align the root .App.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to every button, link, form input, menu, error message, and tab.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced UI (dropdowns, calendars, etc). Use Shadcn JS versions if available or build cleanly.
instructions_to_main_agent.headers: NEVER use a fully transparent header over content without a scrim or blur.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner components are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
